subject.title: feat(memory): add excludePaths option to memorySearch config

question: Should OpenClaw expose `memorySearch.excludePaths` as a public builtin-only configuration contract while QMD continues to ignore it?
rationale: The patch is a new user-facing config surface with intentionally different backend behavior; source review can verify its mechanics but cannot decide whether that product split is the desired permanent contract.

options.title: Sponsor builtin-only exclusions
options.body: Accept the documented builtin-only scope, remove the unrelated CodeQL exception, and approve the direct dependency change before merge.

options.title: Require a unified backend design
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define how QMD and builtin indexing should share or intentionally diverge on exclusion semantics.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Keep the request tracked by the canonical issue and ask for a smaller owner-approved implementation with an existing configuration seam.

recommendation.title: Sponsor builtin-only exclusions
recommendation.body: Accept the documented builtin-only scope, remove the unrelated CodeQL exception, and approve the direct dependency change before merge.
